svg.font-family: DM Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Hopf bifurcation: supercritical, a small stable cycle appears; subcritical, an unstable cycle shrinks onto the steady state
svg.text: Filled dot: stable steady state. Open dot: unstable. Solid ring: stable cycle; dashed: unstable cycle.
